name: microapps
description: Demo de micro apps móviles con Expo + Re.Pack (Module Federation) + Floci (S3 local)

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{require('@swc/core');console.log('✓ @swc/core OK')}catch(e){console.warn('⚠ @swc/core: corre npm approve-scripts @swc/core si el build de Re.Pack falla')}"
scripts.start:all: npx concurrently -n host,catalog,profile -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start -w host" "npm run start -w catalog" "npm run start -w profile"
scripts.prebuild: npm run prebuild -w host && node scripts/patch-native.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w host && npm run typecheck -w catalog && npm run typecheck -w profile
